title: Binance Spot WebSocket Market Streams
supported_mechanism_claims: Spot trade and book-ticker streams expose different message semantics and cadence; bookTicker provides top-of-book updates, not full-depth executions.
Stream event/trade clocks and local receipt times must not be assumed interchangeable when aligning venues.
scope_note: Public endpoint documentation only; no inference of archived feed completeness, executable cross-venue prices, or BTCUSDT returns.

title: OKX API Guide: WebSocket Market Data and Order Book Channels
supported_mechanism_claims: The OKX books5 channel publishes top-five book snapshots at its documented cadence, whereas bbo-tbt and incremental depth streams have different semantics.
Snapshot cadence, empty/unchanged periods and market instrument identity require care before causal cross-venue quote comparison.
scope_note: Public endpoint description, not a statement that archived R0 feeds contain full OKX depth, trades, or reliable arbitrage capacity.
